messages:
anya: FYI CS escalation from Acme Payments — console analytics filters not being applied. They set Region=eu-west-1 + Model=gpt-4o-mini-v2 but the charts still show global totals. Customer ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4921 :exclamation:
ops-bot: Incident created CS-4921, severity=P2. Assigned: @eli, @lucy 
eli: can you paste exact repro steps and a screenshot? also timeframe and one example request_id if you have it 
anya: repro steps below (I reproduced on my account):
1) Console -> Analytics -> Routes -> select route "payments/charge"
2) Apply filters: Region: "eu-west-1", Model: "gpt-4o-mini-v2", Version: "v2026-03-10"
3) Time range: Last 7 days
4) Observe "Token usage by Region" pie and the per-region breakdown — still shows majority us-east-1 numbers even though region filter is set.
Screenshot attached to ticket. Also grabbing the console query payload:```json
{"filters": {"region":["eu-west-1"], "model":["gpt-4o-mini-v2"], "version":["v2026-03-10"]}, "metrics": ["tokens"], "route": "payments/charge", "start": 1762815200, "end": 1763420000}```
priya: customer is seeing billing mismatch because the per-region breakdown they used to reconcile costs is incorrect. They flagged a spike in billed tokens for us-east-1 even though traffic was routed to eu-west-1. This caused an accounting alert on their side. Need an ETA. 
lucy: quick look from metrics-agg side — I can reproduce a similar output when multiple list filters are provided. It looks like our filter normalization step in metrics-aggregator sometimes drops the "region" key and falls back to global rollups; likely when both model+region arrays are present. Taking a deeper look at rollup keys in S3.
eli: can you paste the raw payload the console backend sent to metrics-aggregator? that will help me trace. also include the X-Request-Id header from the console request if available.
anya: raw public payload above. Console request headers include: X-Request-Id: req_0a12b3c4 and Authorization: Bearer redacted (ticket has full headers).
tomas: found something suspicious in console-server: frontend sends filter key "region" but the metrics service expects "region_code" in the rollup query. missing mapping causes the backend to omit region constraint and query global rollups. snippet from console-server:```js
// bad mapping
const filters = req.body.filters || {};
if (!filters.region_code) {
  // fall back to global aggregation
}
```
I think a quick server-side mapping of synonyms (region -> region_code) will fix the symptom immediately. I'll open a tiny patch.
eli: ok assigning to me for hotfix + coord with eng-sre to invalidate caches. lucy — can you confirm whether cached rollups are affected or this is purely a filter translation bug?
lucy: both, unfortunately. The translation bug means we requested global rollups; those got cached at CDN/fast-edge so even after we fix the mapping clients will read cached global data for a short window. We should: 1) patch mapping, 2) purge CDN key for /metrics/rollups?route=payments/charge&* and 3) re-run rollup job for route for the last 7 days. I can trigger re-rollup for the route once the mapping is live.
eli: noted. Eng-sre @deploy-bot can you run a CDN purge for path: `/metrics/rollups?route=payments/charge&*` and also drop fast-edge cache for the rollup key prefix?
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Running CDN purge now. Job id: purge_7721. ETA ~ 6 minutes.
priya: customer communication: please advise immediate workaround. We told them to pull raw logs via API as a temp workaround: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" "https://api.redwood.com/v1/usage?route=payments/charge&region_code=eu-west-1&start=...&end=..."` — that returns correct per-region numbers. If we can get an ETA on a fix I'll update the CS ticket.
eli: ETA for code fix + deployment ~1.5-2 hours (small mapping change + unit test). CDN purge running now. lucy — after purge can you kick the re-rollup for the 7-day window?
lucy: yes I will. once patch is live I'll run: `POST /internal/rollups/rebuild?route=payments/charge&start=1762815200&end=1763420000` and verify S3 keys.
anya: thanks all — updating the customer: temporary workaround (raw usage API), we have a hotfix in progress, CDN purge in flight, and a re-rollup planned after deploy. ETA ~2 hours. I'll post updates to CS-4921. :thumbsup:
eli: I'll follow up here once deploy goes green and re-rollup completes.
ops-bot: Severity updated to P2 -> P3 after patch scheduled and CDN purge started.
anya: closing loop for now, will re-open thread if anything else pops up.
